title: Winspace return policy
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Customers may apply for a return within 14 days of delivery; the item must be unused, in the condition received and in its original packaging, with a receipt or proof of purchase, and the return address must be confirmed with customer service. Custom-order or personalised items have no 14-day refund right. A consumer-caused return is shipped at the consumer's cost; damaged or incorrect goods are not. No restocking fee is charged.
